sub_questions.solution: To determine Arjun's status, we compare his old share to his new share using a common denominator of 30. His old share in the 4:3:3 ratio was 3/10, which equates to 9/30. sub_questions.text: नीरू तथा मीतू क्रमशः ₹ 2,00,000 तथा ₹ 1,50,000 की पूँजी के साथ एक फर्म में साझेदार हैं। 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में यदि फर्म का अर्जित लाभ ₹ 17,500 है, तो 10% वार्षिक दर से उनकी पूँजी पर ब्याज होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Neeru and Meetu are partners in a firm with capitals of ₹ 2,00,000 and ₹ 1,50,000 respectively. If the firm earned a profit of ₹ 17,500 for the year ended 31st March, 2023, then interest on capital @ 10% p.a. would be :
sub_questions.solution: The full 10% interest on capital required is ₹20,000 for Neeru and ₹15,000 for Meetu, requiring a total of ₹35,000. However, the firm's available profit is only ₹17,500, which is insufficient. Consequently, the available profit must be strictly distributed in the ratio of their interest claims (20,000 : 15,000, simplifying to 4:3). Distributing ₹17,500 in a 4:3 ratio provides Neeru with ₹10,000 and Meetu with ₹7,500.

questions.text: एक फर्म के विघटन के समय कुल परिसम्पत्तियाँ ₹ 6,00,000 तथा बाह्य देयताएँ ₹ 2,40,000 थीं । यदि परिसम्पत्तियों से ₹ 7,20,000 की वसूली हुई तथा ₹ 8,000 के वसूली व्ययों का भुगतान किया गया, तो वसूली पर लाभ अथवा हानि होगी :
questions.text_english: At the time of dissolution of a firm, the total assets were ₹ 6,00,000 and outside liabilities were ₹ 2,40,000. If assets realised ₹ 7,20,000 and realisation expenses of ₹ 8,000 were paid, the profit or loss on realisation will be :
questions.solution: In the Realisation Account, the debit side records the book value of transferred total assets (₹6,00,000), payment of liabilities (assumed in full at ₹2,40,000), and realisation expenses (₹8,000), accumulating to a total debit of ₹8,48,000. The credit side logs the book value of transferred outside liabilities (₹2,40,000) alongside the cash realised purely from assets (₹7,20,000), summing up to ₹9,60,000. The difference between the heavier credit side and the debit side reveals a definitive realisation profit standing at exactly ₹1,12,000.
questions.solution_hindi: वसूली खाते में, डेबिट पक्ष हस्तांतरित कुल संपत्तियों का पुस्तक मूल्य (₹6,00,000), देनदारियों का भुगतान (₹2,40,000 पूर्ण रूप से माना गया), और वसूली व्यय (₹8,000) दर्ज करता है, जो कुल ₹8,48,000 के डेबिट में जमा होता है। क्रेडिट पक्ष हस्तांतरित बाह्य देनदारियों (₹2,40,000) के साथ-साथ केवल संपत्तियों से प्राप्त नकद (₹7,20,000) को दर्ज करता है, जो कुल मिलाकर ₹9,60,000 हो जाता है। भारी क्रेडिट पक्ष और डेबिट पक्ष के बीच का अंतर ठीक ₹1,12,000 पर खड़े एक निश्चित वसूली लाभ को दर्शाता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : जब साझेदारी का विघटन होता है, तो न्यायालय का हस्तक्षेप नहीं होता ।
कारण (R) : साझेदारी का विघटन साझेदारों के बीच आपसी सहमति द्वारा होता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The court does not intervene when dissolution of partnership takes place.
Reason (R): Dissolution of partnership takes place by mutual agreement between the partners.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: Dissolution of partnership fundamentally refers to an internal reconstitution or change in the existing relationship among partners, such as through admission, retirement, or a change in profit-sharing ratio. This process is inherently voluntary and driven strictly by mutual agreement among the partners, which firmly validates the Reason. Because it relies entirely on private mutual consent rather than legal termination of the firm, the court plays no role, making the Assertion correct and perfectly explained by the Reason.
questions.solution_hindi: साझेदारी के विघटन का मूल रूप से अर्थ है एक आंतरिक पुनर्गठन या साझेदारों के बीच मौजूदा संबंधों में बदलाव, जैसे कि प्रवेश, सेवानिवृत्ति, या लाभ-साझाकरण अनुपात में बदलाव के माध्यम से। यह प्रक्रिया स्वाभाविक रूप से स्वैच्छिक है और सख्ती से भागीदारों के बीच आपसी सहमति से संचालित होती है, जो कारण को मजबूती से मान्य करती है। क्योंकि यह पूरी तरह से फर्म की कानूनी समाप्ति के बजाय निजी आपसी सहमति पर निर्भर करता है, न्यायालय कोई भूमिका नहीं निभाता है, जिससे अभिकथन सही हो जाता है और कारण द्वारा पूरी तरह से समझाया जाता है।

sub_questions.text_english: Kishore and Bimal are partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3. Nand is admitted as a new partner in the firm for 1/4th share in the profits. Kishore and Bimal decide to share profits and losses equally in the future. The sacrificing ratio of Kishore and Bimal will be :
sub_questions.solution: Nand claims a 1/4th share, leaving a residual 3/4th share for the remaining firm. Kishore and Bimal decide to share this residual equally, so their new individual shares are half of 3/4, which is 3/8 each. The sacrifice is precisely calculated as Old Share minus New Share. For Kishore, this is 4/7 - 3/8 = (32 - 21)/56 = 11/56. For Bimal, it is 3/7 - 3/8 = (24 - 21)/56 = 3/56. Comparing their sacrificed fractions yields a strict sacrificing ratio of 11:3.

sub_questions.text: राजू, सोहन और टीना एक फर्म में साझेदार हैं तथा 2:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते हैं। टीना को लाभ के भाग के रूप में प्रति वर्ष न्यूनतम ₹ 40,000 की गारंटी दी गई। इस कारण हुई किसी भी कमी को राजू द्वारा वहन किया जाएगा । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष में यदि फर्म का लाभ ₹ 1,60,000 है, तो राजू द्वारा वहन की जाने वाली कमी होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Raju, Sohan and Tina are partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:2:1. Tina is guaranteed a minimum amount of ₹ 40,000 as share of profit every year. Any deficiency arising on that account shall be borne by Raju. If profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2023 is ₹ 1,60,000, Raju will bear a deficiency of:
sub_questions.solution: Tina is fundamentally entitled to a 1/5th share of the firm's total profit. Calculating 1/5th of ₹1,60,000 gives her an actual profit share of ₹32,000. Because she was personally guaranteed a strict minimum of ₹40,000, there is a clear deficiency. Subtracting her actual share (₹32,000) from her guaranteed minimum (₹40,000) isolates a deficiency of exactly ₹8,000. Under the partnership agreement, Raju personally bears this entire burden.

questions.text: महाराजा लिमिटेड ने डोलफिन लिमिटेड की ₹ 15,00,000 की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा ₹ 2,00,000 की देयताओं का अधिग्रहण ₹ 12,60,000 के सहमत क्रय मूल्य पर किया । यह सहमति हुई कि क्रय मूल्य का भुगतान ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 11% ऋणपत्रों को 10% छूट पर निर्गमित करके किया जाएगा। निर्गमित ऋणपत्रों की संख्या होगी :
questions.text_english: Maharaja Ltd. took over assets of ₹ 15,00,000 and liabilities of ₹ 2,00,000 of Dolphin Ltd. for an agreed purchase consideration of ₹ 12,60,000. It was agreed that the purchase consideration will be paid by issuing 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at 10% discount. The number of debentures issued will be :
questions.solution: The purchase consideration firmly owed to Dolphin Ltd. is specified as ₹12,60,000. The debentures are explicitly issued at a 10% discount on their ₹100 face value, establishing the actual issue price per debenture at ₹90. To find the exact number of debentures to be issued, the total purchase consideration (₹12,60,000) is simply divided by the issue price per debenture (₹90), resulting in exactly 14,000 debentures.
questions.solution_hindi: डॉल्फिन लिमिटेड को देय क्रय प्रतिफल स्पष्ट रूप से ₹12,60,000 के रूप में निर्दिष्ट है। ऋणपत्र स्पष्ट रूप से उनके ₹100 के अंकित मूल्य पर 10% की छूट पर जारी किए जाते हैं, जिससे प्रति डिबेंचर वास्तविक निर्गम मूल्य ₹90 स्थापित होता है। जारी किए जाने वाले डिबेंचर की सटीक संख्या ज्ञात करने के लिए, कुल क्रय प्रतिफल (₹12,60,000) को प्रति डिबेंचर निर्गम मूल्य (₹90) से विभाजित किया जाता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप ठीक 14,000 डिबेंचर प्राप्त होते हैं।

questions.text_english: Misha Ltd. issued 6,000, 8% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at ₹ 96 per debenture. 8% Debentures Account will be credited by:
questions.solution: In accounting rules, irrespective of the premium or discount attached to the issue price, the core Debentures Account must always be credited with the absolute face (nominal) value of the debentures. For 6,000 debentures with a face value of ₹100 each, the account is credited with exactly ₹6,00,000.

sub_questions.text: यदि ₹ 100 के एक अंश/शेयर का हरण (forfeit) कर लिया गया है जिस पर ₹ 70 का भुगतान किया जा चुका है, तो इसे कितने न्यूनतम मूल्य पर पुनः निर्गमित किया जा सकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: If a share of ₹ 100 on which ₹ 70 has been paid is forfeited, then at which minimum price can it be re-issued ?
sub_questions.solution: The maximum permissible discount a company can offer on the reissue of forfeited shares is strictly limited to the amount already forfeited on those shares. Since ₹70 was already paid and forfeited, the company can offer a maximum discount of ₹70 on a ₹100 share. Thus, the minimum reissue price is the difference between the face value and the forfeited amount, which stands at ₹30.

sub_questions.text: यदि ₹ 10 के एक अंश/शेयर का हरण (forfeit) कर लिया गया है जिसे ₹ 2 प्रति अंश/शेयर प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित किया गया था तथा जिस पर ₹ 8 (प्रीमियम सहित) माँगे गए थे तथा अंशधारी / शेयरधारी ने ₹ 6 (प्रीमियम सहित) का भुगतान कर दिया था, तो अंश/शेयर पूँजी खाता नाम होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: If a share of ₹ 10 issued at a premium of ₹ 2 per share, on which ₹ 8 (including premium) has been called and ₹ 6 (including premium) has been paid by the shareholder, is forfeited, then Share Capital Account will be debited with :
sub_questions.solution: When shares are forfeited, the Share Capital Account is debited exclusively with the called-up capital value of the shares up to the point of forfeiture, completely excluding any securities premium. The total called-up amount was ₹8, which included a ₹2 premium. Therefore, the pure capital called-up is ₹8 minus ₹2, making it exactly ₹6 per share.

questions.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2022 को मेगा लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 30,000, 10% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 10% बट्टे पर किया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष में ऋणपत्रों पर देय ब्याज की कुल राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: On 1st April, 2022, Mega Ltd. issued 30,000, 10% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a discount of 10%. The total amount of interest due on debentures for the year ending 31st March, 2023 will be:
questions.solution: Interest on debentures is always calculated purely on their nominal or face value, completely irrespective of whether they were issued at a discount or a premium. The total face value of the issued debentures stands at ₹30,00,000 (30,000 multiplied by ₹100). The annual interest required at the rate of 10% on this ₹30,00,000 face value is strictly ₹3,00,000.

questions.text: मानस और रनवीर एक फर्म में साझेदार हैं, जिनके पूँजी शेष क्रमशः ₹ 1,20,000 तथा ₹ 80,000 हैं। संजू को फर्म के भावी लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया गया । संजू अपनी पूँजी के रूप में ₹ 1,00,000 लाया। संजू के प्रवेश पर फर्म की ख्याति होगी :
questions.text_english: Manas and Ranvir are partners in a firm having capital balances of ₹ 1,20,000 and ₹ 80,000 respectively. Sanju is admitted as a new partner in the firm for 1/5th share in future profits. Sanju brought ₹ 1,00,000 as his capital. The goodwill of the firm on Sanju's admission will be:
questions.solution: The concept of hidden goodwill is applied here. The total implied capital of the newly reconstituted firm is calculated based on Sanju's contribution: ₹1,00,000 multiplied by the reciprocal of his share (5), resulting in ₹5,00,000. However, the actual combined capital of all partners including Sanju is ₹1,20,000 + ₹80,000 + ₹1,00,000, which strictly sums to ₹3,00,000. The excess of the implied total capital over the actual combined capital constitutes the hidden goodwill of the firm, calculating out to ₹5,00,000 - ₹3,00,000 = ₹2,00,000.
questions.solution_hindi: यहां छिपी हुई ख्याति (hidden goodwill) की अवधारणा लागू की गई है। नवगठित फर्म की कुल निहित पूंजी की गणना संजू के योगदान के आधार पर की जाती है: ₹1,00,000 को उसके हिस्से के व्युत्क्रम (5) से गुणा किया जाता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप ₹5,00,000 प्राप्त होता है। हालांकि, संजू सहित सभी साझेदारों की वास्तविक संयुक्त पूंजी ₹1,20,000 + ₹80,000 + ₹1,00,000 है, जो सख्ती से ₹3,00,000 होती है। वास्तविक संयुक्त पूंजी पर निहित कुल पूंजी की अधिकता फर्म की छिपी हुई ख्याति का गठन करती है, जिसकी गणना ₹5,00,000 - ₹3,00,000 = ₹2,00,000 के रूप में की जाती है।

questions.text: यदि साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते स्थायी हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी मद का लेखा साझेदारों के पूँजी खातों में नहीं किया जाएगा ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following items cannot be recorded in the capital account of partners if the capital accounts of partners are fixed ?
questions.solution: Under the fixed capital account method, all routine transactions such as regular drawings against expected profits, interest on capital, and salary are recorded exclusively in the partners' current accounts. The capital account itself only records the opening balance, introduction of fresh capital, and permanent withdrawal of capital, meaning normal drawings cannot be recorded there.
questions.solution_hindi: स्थायी पूंजी खाता पद्धति के तहत, लाभ के विरुद्ध नियमित आहरण, पूंजी पर ब्याज और वेतन जैसे सभी नियमित लेनदेन विशेष रूप से साझेदारों के चालू खातों में दर्ज किए जाते हैं। पूंजी खाते में केवल प्रारंभिक शेष, नई पूंजी का प्रवेश और पूंजी की स्थायी निकासी दर्ज की जाती है, जिसका अर्थ है कि सामान्य आहरण को वहां दर्ज नहीं किया जा सकता है।

अभिकथन (A) : एक साझेदारी फर्म में नया साझेदार प्रवेश पर पूँजी की एक सहमत राशि नगद या वस्तु रूप में लाता है ।
कारण (R) : एक साझेदारी फर्म में नया साझेदार प्रवेश पर साझेदारी फर्म की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा लाभों में भाग लेने का अधिकार ग्रहण करता है।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): In a partnership firm, at the time of admission, the new partner brings in an agreed amount of capital either in cash or in kind.
Reason (R): In a partnership firm, at the time of admission, the new partner acquires the right to share the assets and the profits of the partnership firm.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: An incoming partner must contribute an agreed amount of capital to essentially buy into the firm's equity. This capital contribution formally grants the new partner the foundational rights to claim a share in the firm's future profits as well as a proportional stake in its existing assets. Because the new partner acquires these specific rights explicitly in exchange for bringing in capital, the Reason serves as a completely accurate and logical explanation for the Assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: एक आने वाले साझेदार को मुख्य रूप से फर्म की इक्विटी में खरीदारी करने के लिए पूंजी की एक सहमत राशि का योगदान करना चाहिए। यह पूंजीगत योगदान औपचारिक रूप से नए साझेदार को फर्म के भविष्य के मुनाफे में हिस्सा लेने के साथ-साथ इसकी मौजूदा संपत्तियों में आनुपातिक हिस्सेदारी का दावा करने का मूलभूत अधिकार प्रदान करता है। क्योंकि नया साझेदार पूंजी लाने के बदले में स्पष्ट रूप से इन विशिष्ट अधिकारों को प्राप्त करता है, इसलिए कारण अभिकथन के लिए पूरी तरह से सटीक और तार्किक स्पष्टीकरण के रूप में कार्य करता है।

sub_questions.text: 1 जनवरी, 2023 को एक साझेदार अभिषेक ने फर्म को ₹ 3,00,000 का अग्रिम ऋण दिया । साझेदारी समझौते की अनुपस्थिति में 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष के लिए ऋण पर ब्याज की राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: On 1st January, 2023, Abhishek, a partner, advanced a loan of ₹ 3,00,000 to the firm. In the absence of a partnership agreement, the amount of interest on the loan for the year ending 31st March, 2023 will be:
sub_questions.solution: In the complete absence of a partnership agreement, the Indian Partnership Act prescribes that a partner who advances a loan to the firm is legally entitled to interest at the strict rate of 6% per annum. Abhishek advanced the loan on 1st January, meaning interest is calculated for exactly 3 months up to 31st March. The calculation is ₹3,00,000 multiplied by 6% and then multiplied by 3/12, which amounts to ₹4,500.

sub_questions.text: यदि कोई साझेदार प्रत्येक तिमाही के अन्त में एक निश्चित राशि का आहरण करता है, तो आहरण पर ________ महीनों के लिए ब्याज प्रभारित किया जाएगा ।
sub_questions.text_english: If a partner withdraws a fixed amount at the end of each quarter, interest on drawings will be charged for ________ months.
sub_questions.solution: When a partner uniformly withdraws a fixed amount at the end of each quarter, the average period for calculating interest on drawings is derived using the standard formula: (Months left after first drawing + Months left after last drawing) divided by 2. The first drawing leaves 9 months and the last leaves 0 months. Averaging 9 and 0 gives precisely 4.5 months.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित काल्पनिक स्थिति को पढ़िए तथा इसमें दी गई सूचना के आधार पर प्रश्न संख्या 14 तथा 15 के उत्तर दीजिए ।
विवेक एवं निशा एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2022 को उनकी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹8,00,000 तथा ₹ 4,00,000 थी । 1 जुलाई, 2022 को विवेक ₹ 2,00,000 की अतिरिक्त पूँजी लाया । वर्ष के दौरान विवेक का आहरण ₹ 40,000 था, जबकि निशा का आहरण ₹ 80,000 था । साझेदारी समझौते के अनुसार, पूँजी पर 6% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज दिया जाएगा । आहरण पर 5% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज प्रभारित किया जाएगा। 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष के लिए शुद्ध लाभ की राशि ₹ 6,50,000 थी ।
निशा के आहरण पर ब्याज की राशि होगी :
questions.text_english:
Read the following hypothetical situation and answer Questions No. 14 and 15 on the basis of the given information.
Vivek and Nisha were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3: 2. On 1st April, 2022, their capitals were ₹ 8,00,000 and ₹ 4,00,000 respectively. On 1st July, 2022, Vivek introduced additional capital of ₹ 2,00,000. During the year, Vivek's drawings were ₹ 40,000 while drawings of Nisha were ₹ 80,000. As per the partnership agreement, interest on capital is allowed @ 6% p.a., interest on drawings will be charged @ 5% p.a. The net profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 6,50,000.
The amount of interest on drawings of Nisha would be :
questions.solution: When the specific dates of drawings made evenly throughout the year are completely absent from the problem, accounting standards dictate that interest must be calculated on an average basis for exactly 6 months. Applying this rule to Nisha's total drawings of ₹80,000 at an interest rate of 5% per annum yields: ₹80,000 × 5% × 6/12, which correctly computes to ₹2,000.
questions.solution_hindi: जब पूरे वर्ष समान रूप से किए गए आहरण की विशिष्ट तिथियां समस्या से पूरी तरह से अनुपस्थित होती हैं, तो लेखांकन मानक यह निर्देशित करते हैं कि ब्याज की गणना ठीक 6 महीने के लिए औसत आधार पर की जानी चाहिए। इस नियम को 5% प्रति वर्ष की ब्याज दर पर निशा के ₹80,000 के कुल आहरण पर लागू करने से प्राप्त होता है: ₹80,000 × 5% × 6/12, जो सही ढंग से ₹2,000 की गणना करता है।

questions.text: विवेक को देय पूँजी पर ब्याज होगा :
questions.text_english: Interest on capital payable to Vivek will be
questions.solution: Interest on Vivek's capital must be split into two strict parts to accommodate the mid-year change. Firstly, interest on the initial opening capital of ₹8,00,000 for the full 12 months is calculated at 6%, yielding ₹48,000. Secondly, interest on the newly introduced additional capital of ₹2,00,000 operates from 1st July to 31st March (exactly 9 months), calculated as ₹2,00,000 × 6% × 9/12, providing an additional ₹9,000. Adding these components together definitively totals to an interest amount of ₹57,000.
questions.solution_hindi: विवेक की पूंजी पर ब्याज को मध्य-वर्ष के बदलाव को समायोजित करने के लिए दो सख्त भागों में विभाजित किया जाना चाहिए। सबसे पहले, पूरे 12 महीनों के लिए ₹8,00,000 की प्रारंभिक प्रारंभिक पूंजी पर ब्याज की गणना 6% पर की जाती है, जिससे ₹48,000 प्राप्त होते हैं। दूसरे, ₹2,0,000 की नई पेश की गई अतिरिक्त पूंजी पर ब्याज 1 जुलाई से 31 मार्च (ठीक 9 महीने) तक संचालित होता है, जिसकी गणना ₹2,0,000 × 6% × 9/12 के रूप में की जाती है, जो अतिरिक्त ₹9,000 प्रदान करता है। इन घटकों को एक साथ जोड़ने पर निश्चित रूप से ₹57,000 की ब्याज राशि होती है।

questions.text: आशु तथा बासु साझेदार हैं तथा 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते हैं। चेतन को एक नए साझेदार के रूप में 1/4 लाभ में भाग के लिए प्रवेश दिया गया जो उसने आशु तथा बासु से बराबर-बराबर अनुपात में प्राप्त किया । आशु, बासु तथा चेतन का नया लाभ विभाजन अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: Ashu and Basu are partners sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2: 1. Chetan is admitted as a new partner with 1/4th share in the profits which he acquires equally from Ashu and Basu. The new profit sharing ratio between Ashu, Basu and Chetan will be :
questions.solution: Chetan is admitted for a 1/4th share, which he acquires equally from Ashu and Basu. This means both Ashu and Basu sacrifice half of 1/4th, equating to a 1/8th share each. Ashu's new share is computed by subtracting his sacrifice (1/8) from his original share (2/3), resulting in 13/24. Basu's new share is his original share (1/3) minus his sacrifice (1/8), resulting in 5/24. Chetan's share is 1/4, which translates to 6/24. Thus, the new profit-sharing ratio perfectly aligns as 13:5:6.
questions.solution_hindi: चेतन को 1/4 हिस्से के लिए प्रवेश दिया जाता है, जिसे वह आशु और बासु से समान रूप से प्राप्त करता है। इसका अर्थ है कि आशु और बासु दोनों 1/4 का आधा त्याग करते हैं, जो प्रत्येक के लिए 1/8 हिस्से के बराबर है। आशु के नए हिस्से की गणना उसके मूल हिस्से (2/3) से उसके त्याग (1/8) को घटाकर की जाती है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप 13/24 प्राप्त होता है। बासु का नया हिस्सा उसका मूल हिस्सा (1/3) माइनस उसका त्याग (1/8) है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप 5/24 प्राप्त होता है। चेतन का हिस्सा 1/4 है, जो 6/24 में बदल जाता है। इस प्रकार, नया लाभ-साझाकरण अनुपात पूरी तरह से 13:5:6 के रूप में संरेखित होता है।

sub_questions.text_english: (a) Prateek, Charu and Sirima were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 3:2:1. Prateek retired from the firm on 31st March, 2023. Charu and Sirima decided that the capital of the new firm will be ₹ 6,30,000. The capital accounts of Charu and Sirima after all adjustments on the date of retirement showed a credit balance of ₹ 4,35,000 and ₹ 1,89,000 respectively. Calculate the amount of actual cash to be brought into the firm or to be paid to the partners. Also pass necessary journal entries.

key_points: Old ratio: Prateek, Charu, Sirima = 3:2:1.
New ratio: Charu and Sirima = 2:1 (since Prateek's share is removed).
Total new capital = ₹6,30,000.
Existing Capital: Charu = ₹4,35,000. Sirima = ₹1,89,000.
Cash to be paid to Charu = 4,35,000 - 4,20,000 = ₹15,000.
Cash to be brought in by Sirima = 2,10,000 - 1,89,000 = ₹21,000.
Entry 1: Charu's Capital A/c Dr 15,000 To Cash/Bank A/c 15,000.
Entry 2: Cash/Bank A/c Dr 21,000 To Sirima's Capital A/c 21,000.

sub_questions.solution: Following Prateek's retirement, the remaining partners Charu and Sirima continue sharing profits in their remaining ratio, which naturally settles to 2:1. The total authorized capital for the newly reconstituted firm is expressly decided as ₹6,30,000. Based on their 2:1 ratio, their target capitals strictly mandate ₹4,20,000 for Charu and ₹2,10,000 for Sirima. Assessing their existing adjusted balances, Charu currently possesses ₹4,35,000. Because this exceeds her required capital, the firm must pay her the excess ₹15,000 in cash. Sirima, holding only ₹1,89,000 against a requirement of ₹2,10,000, faces a deficit and must bring in an additional ₹21,000 in cash. The journal entries sequentially reflect these cash flows: debiting Charu's Capital Account and crediting Cash/Bank for ₹15,000 to record the payout, and conversely debiting Cash/Bank while crediting Sirima's Capital Account for ₹21,000 to formally log her capital injection.

sub_questions.text: (ख) चमन, बर्मन तथा अमन एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । अमन को प्रति वर्ष उसके लाभ के भाग के रूप में न्यूनतम ₹ 60,000 की गारंटी दी गई थी । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष के लिए शुद्ध लाभ की राशि ₹ 1,20,000 थी । फर्म की पुस्तकों में साझेदारों के बीच लाभ-विभाजन दर्शाते हुए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Chaman, Burman and Aman were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. Aman was guaranteed a minimum amount of ₹ 60,000 as his share of profit every year. The net profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 1,20,000. Pass necessary journal entries in the books of the firm showing the distribution of profit amongst the partners.

key_points: Total Profit = ₹1,20,000.
Initial Distribution (3:2:1): Chaman = 60,000; Burman = 40,000; Aman = 20,000.
Aman's guaranteed profit = ₹60,000. Deficiency = 60,000 - 20,000 = ₹40,000.
Deficiency borne by Chaman and Burman in their ratio 3:2.
Entry: Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr 1,20,000 To Chaman's Capital A/c 36,000 To Burman's Capital A/c 24,000 To Aman's Capital A/c 60,000.

sub_questions.solution: The firm generated a total profit of ₹1,20,000. Distributing this in the standard 3:2:1 ratio assigns initial shares of ₹60,000 to Chaman, ₹40,000 to Burman, and a mere ₹20,000 to Aman. Because Aman is formally guaranteed a minimum profit of ₹60,000, he suffers a heavy deficiency of ₹40,000. Under the guarantee mechanics, Chaman and Burman must personally bear this deficiency in their specific mutual ratio of 3:2. Consequently, Chaman sacrifices ₹24,000 (3/5 of 40k) and Burman sacrifices ₹16,000 (2/5 of 40k). This adjusts the final allocated profits precisely to ₹36,000 for Chaman, ₹24,000 for Burman, and the fully guaranteed ₹60,000 for Aman. The journal entry debits the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the entire ₹1,20,000 and distinctly credits Chaman's, Burman's, and Aman's Capital Accounts with their respective finalized amounts.

questions.text:
मधु, राज, अतुल तथा प्राची एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:4:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने लाभ-हानि को बराबर-बराबर अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। उनका स्थिति विवरण ₹ 1,00,000 का सामान्य संचय दर्शा रहा था। फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 20,00,000 किया गया ।
लाभ विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के कारण उपर्युक्त के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए । अपने कार्य को स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए ।
questions.text_english:
Madhu, Raj, Atul and Prachi were partners in a firm sharing profit and losses in the ratio of 3:2:4:1. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they decided to share profits and losses equally. Their Balance Sheet showed a General Reserve of ₹ 1,00,000. The goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 20,00,000.
Pass necessary journal entries for the above on account of change in the profit sharing ratio. Show your working clearly.

key_points: Old Ratio: Madhu, Raj, Atul, Prachi = 3:2:4:1 (3/10, 2/10, 4/10, 1/10).
New Ratio: Equal (1/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4).
Sacrifice/Gain = Old Share - New Share. LCM = 40.
Combined adjusting amount = General Reserve (1,00,000) + Goodwill (20,00,000) = ₹21,00,000.
Entry: Raj's Capital A/c Dr 1,05,000, Prachi's Capital A/c Dr 3,15,000 To Madhu's Capital A/c 1,05,000 To Atul's Capital A/c 3,15,000.

questions.solution: When partners change their profit-sharing ratio without expressly closing reserves, a single adjusting entry handles both goodwill and accumulated reserves. First, establish the combined adjustment amount by aggregating the General Reserve (₹1,00,000) and the valued Goodwill (₹20,00,000), making a massive total of ₹21,00,000. Next, calculate the sacrificing or gaining fraction for each partner by subtracting their new share (1/4) from their old share (using a common denominator of 40). Madhu's change is 12/40 - 10/40 = 2/40 (Sacrifice). Raj's is 8/40 - 10/40 = -2/40 (Gain). Atul's is 16/40 - 10/40 = 6/40 (Sacrifice). Prachi's is 4/40 - 10/40 = -6/40 (Gain). The required compensation is computed by multiplying these fractions against the ₹21,00,000 total. The gaining partners (Raj and Prachi) must compensate the sacrificing partners (Madhu and Atul). Consequently, the journal entry cleanly debits Raj's Capital Account for ₹1,05,000 and Prachi's Capital Account for ₹3,15,000, while crediting Madhu's Capital Account for ₹1,05,000 and Atul's Capital Account for ₹3,15,000.
questions.solution_hindi: जब साझेदार भंडार को स्पष्ट रूप से बंद किए बिना अपने लाभ-साझाकरण अनुपात को बदलते हैं, तो एक एकल समायोजन प्रविष्टि ख्याति और संचित भंडार दोनों को संभालती है। सबसे पहले, सामान्य संचय (₹1,00,000) और मूल्यांकित ख्याति (₹20,00,000) को जोड़कर संयुक्त समायोजन राशि स्थापित करें, जो कुल ₹21,00,000 है। इसके बाद, 40 के सामान्य हर का उपयोग करके उनके पुराने हिस्से से उनका नया हिस्सा (1/4) घटाकर प्रत्येक भागीदार के लिए त्याग या लाभ प्राप्त करने वाले अंश की गणना करें। मधु का परिवर्तन 12/40 - 10/40 = 2/40 (त्याग) है। राज का 8/40 - 10/40 = -2/40 (लाभ) है। अतुल का 16/40 - 10/40 = 6/40 (त्याग) है। प्राची का 4/40 - 10/40 = -6/40 (लाभ) है। आवश्यक मुआवजे की गणना इन भिन्नों को ₹21,00,000 के कुल योग से गुणा करके की जाती है। लाभ प्राप्त करने वाले भागीदारों (राज और प्राची) को त्याग करने वाले भागीदारों (मधु और अतुल) को मुआवजा देना चाहिए। नतीजतन, रोजनामचा प्रविष्टि राज के पूंजी खाते को ₹1,05,000 और प्राची के पूंजी खाते को ₹3,15,000 के लिए डेबिट करती है, जबकि मधु के पूंजी खाते को ₹1,05,000 और अतुल के पूंजी खाते को ₹3,15,000 के लिए क्रेडिट करती है।

sub_questions.text: (क) प्रीति लिमिटेड ने पायल लिमिटेड से ₹ 5,40,000 की परिसम्पत्तियाँ तथा ₹ 1,20,000 की देयताओं का अधिग्रहण ₹ 5,28,000 के क्रय मूल्य पर किया । प्रीति लिमिटेड ने आधी राशि का भुगतान एक चैक द्वारा तथा शेष राशि का भुगतान ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 10% ऋणपत्रों को 10% प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित करके किया । उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए प्रीति लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Priti Ltd. purchased assets worth ₹ 5,40,000 and took over liabilities of ₹ 1,20,000 of Payal Ltd. for a purchase consideration of ₹ 5,28,000. Priti Ltd. paid half the amount by cheque and the balance was settled by issuing 10% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 10%. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Priti Ltd.

key_points: Net assets acquired = Assets (5,40,000) - Liabilities (1,20,000) = ₹4,20,000.
Purchase consideration = ₹5,28,000.
Goodwill = Purchase Consideration - Net Assets = 5,28,000 - 4,20,000 = ₹1,08,000.
Entry 1: Assets A/c Dr 5,40,000, Goodwill A/c Dr 1,08,000 To Liabilities A/c 1,20,000 To Payal Ltd 5,28,000.
Half amount paid by cheque = ₹5,28,000 / 2 = ₹2,64,000.
Entry 2: Payal Ltd Dr 2,64,000 To Bank A/c 2,64,000.
Balance ₹2,64,000 paid by debentures at 10% premium. Issue price = ₹110.
Number of debentures = 2,64,000 / 110 = 2,400 debentures.
Entry 3: Payal Ltd Dr 2,64,000 To 10% Debentures A/c 2,40,000 To Securities Premium Reserve A/c 24,000.

sub_questions.solution: When Priti Ltd. acquires Payal Ltd., the net assets received are ₹4,20,000 (Assets of ₹5,40,000 less Liabilities of ₹1,20,000). Since the agreed purchase consideration is much higher at ₹5,28,000, the excess ₹1,08,000 represents the Goodwill acquired. The first entry debits Assets (₹5,40,000) and Goodwill (₹1,08,000) while crediting Liabilities (₹1,20,000) and Payal Ltd. (₹5,28,000). To settle the consideration, exactly half (₹2,64,000) is paid via bank, so Payal Ltd. is debited and Bank is credited for ₹2,64,000. The remaining ₹2,64,000 is settled by issuing debentures at a 10% premium, making the issue price ₹110 each. Dividing ₹2,64,000 by ₹110 determines that 2,400 debentures are required. The final entry debits Payal Ltd. for ₹2,64,000, crediting 10% Debentures for the face value of ₹2,40,000 and Securities Premium Reserve for the remaining ₹24,000.

sub_questions.text: (ख) धातु लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 4,000, 11% ऋणपत्रों को ₹ 50 प्रति ऋणपत्र प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित करने के लिए आवेदन आमंत्रित किए। पूरी राशि का भुगतान आवेदन पर देय था । 5,000 ऋणपत्रों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए । 1,000 ऋणपत्रों के आवेदनों को रद्द कर दिया गया तथा आवेदन राशि वापस कर दी गई। शेष आवेदकों को ऋणपत्रों का आबंटन कर दिया गया । धातु लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Dhatu Ltd. invited applications for issuing 4,000, 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of ₹ 50 per debenture. Full amount was payable on application. Applications were received for 5,000 debentures. Applications for 1,000 debentures were rejected and application money was refunded. Debentures were allotted to the remaining applicants. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Dhatu Ltd.

key_points: Issue price per debenture = Face value (100) + Premium (50) = ₹150.
Total application money received for 5,000 debentures = 5,000 × 150 = ₹7,50,000.
Entry 1: Bank A/c Dr 7,50,000 To Debenture Application & Allotment A/c 7,50,000.
Refund for 1,000 rejected debentures = 1,000 × 150 = ₹1,50,000.
Amount transferred to Debentures = 4,000 × 100 = ₹4,00,000.
Amount transferred to Securities Premium = 4,000 × 50 = ₹2,00,000.
Entry 2: Debenture Application & Allotment A/c Dr 7,50,000 To 11% Debentures A/c 4,00,000 To Securities Premium Reserve A/c 2,00,000 To Bank A/c 1,50,000.

sub_questions.solution: The issue price of each debenture stands at ₹150, consisting of the ₹100 face value and a heavy ₹50 premium. Because the entire amount is payable upfront on application, the initial receipt entry captures the total applications. For 5,000 applications, the firm receives ₹7,50,000 (5,000 × ₹150), prompting a debit to Bank and a credit to Debenture Application and Allotment for ₹7,50,000. Subsequently, the allotment process resolves the oversubscription. The firm cleanly rejects 1,000 applications, strictly refunding their ₹1,50,000 (1,000 × ₹150) through the Bank. For the remaining 4,000 accepted debentures, the collected money is formally split: ₹4,00,000 (4,000 × ₹100) is credited to the 11% Debentures account, and the accumulated premium of ₹2,00,000 (4,000 × ₹50) is rightly credited to the Securities Premium Reserve. The second journal entry neatly consolidates this entire distribution.

questions.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2023 को कशिश तथा सागर की फर्म की पुस्तकें ₹ 9,00,000 की परिसम्पत्तियाँ दर्शा रही थीं जिसमें ₹ 32,000 नगद तथा ₹ 1,68,000 का बैंक शेष सम्मिलित था । साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते ₹ 6,00,000 का शेष दर्शा रहे थे और बाकी की राशि का संचय था । यदि लाभ की सामान्य प्रतिफल दर 8% है तथा फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन अधिलाभों के 5 वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर ₹ 4,00,000 किया गया है, तो फर्म के औसत लाभों को ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: On 1st April, 2023, the books of the firm of Kashish and Sagar showed assets of ₹ 9,00,000 including cash of ₹ 32,000 and bank balance of ₹ 1,68,000. The partners' capital accounts showed balance of ₹ 6,00,000 and reserves constituted the rest. If the normal rate of return is 8% and the goodwill of the firm is valued at ₹ 4,00,000 at 5 years purchase of super profits, find the average profits of the firm.

key_points: Capital Employed = Total Assets - Outside Liabilities. Here, Outside Liabilities are 0 (as Capital + Reserves = Total Assets). Therefore, Capital Employed = ₹9,00,000.
Normal Profit = Capital Employed × Normal Rate of Return = 9,00,000 × 8% = ₹72,000.
Goodwill = Super Profit × Number of Years Purchase. So, 4,00,000 = Super Profit × 5.
Super Profit = Average Profit - Normal Profit.
Average Profit = Super Profit + Normal Profit = 80,000 + 72,000 = ₹1,52,000.

questions.solution: First, the firm's Capital Employed must be established. Since the problem explicitly states the assets total ₹9,00,000 and the liabilities side consists solely of partners' capital (₹6,00,000) and reserves (which make up the remaining ₹3,00,000), there are absolutely no outside liabilities. Thus, the Capital Employed is cleanly ₹9,00,000. The Normal Profit generated on this capital at an 8% rate evaluates to ₹72,000. Next, goodwill is provided as ₹4,00,000, based precisely on 5 years' purchase of super profits. Dividing the goodwill by 5 yields the Super Profit, which stands at ₹80,000. Because Super Profit represents the excess of average profits over normal profits, the firm's true Average Profit is uncovered by simply adding the Normal Profit back to the Super Profit. Summing ₹72,000 and ₹80,000 ultimately reveals an Average Profit of exactly ₹1,52,000.
questions.solution_hindi: सबसे पहले, फर्म की नियोजित पूंजी स्थापित की जानी चाहिए। चूंकि समस्या स्पष्ट रूप से बताती है कि कुल संपत्ति ₹9,00,000 है और देनदारियों के पक्ष में पूरी तरह से साझेदारों की पूंजी (₹6,00,000) और भंडार (जो शेष ₹3,00,000 बनाते हैं) शामिल हैं, इसलिए कोई बाहरी देनदारियां नहीं हैं। इस प्रकार, नियोजित पूंजी साफ तौर पर ₹9,00,000 है। 8% की दर से इस पूंजी पर उत्पन्न सामान्य लाभ ₹72,000 का मूल्यांकन करता है। इसके बाद, ख्याति ₹4,00,000 के रूप में प्रदान की जाती है, जो कि अधिलाभ के 5 वर्षों की खरीद पर आधारित है। ख्याति को 5 से विभाजित करने पर अधिलाभ प्राप्त होता है, जो ₹80,000 है। क्योंकि अधिलाभ सामान्य लाभ पर औसत लाभ की अधिकता का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, फर्म का सही औसत लाभ सामान्य लाभ को अधिलाभ में वापस जोड़कर सामने लाया जाता है। ₹72,000 और ₹80,000 को जोड़ने पर अंततः ठीक ₹1,52,000 का औसत लाभ प्रकट होता है।

questions.text:
अदिति, रेनू एवं वर्षा एक फर्म में साझेदार थीं तथा 3:2:5 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करती थीं । 31 मार्च, 2023 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार से था :
31 मार्च, 2023 को अदिति, रेनू एवं वर्षा का स्थिति विवरण

| देयताएँ | राशि ₹ | परिसम्पत्तियाँ | राशि ₹ |
|---|---|---|---|
| पूँजी : अदिति | 5,00,000 | भवन | 6,00,000 |
| रेनू | 4,00,000 | मशीनरी | 3,00,000 |
| वर्षा | 3,00,000 | स्टॉक | 1,00,000 |
| | 12,00,000 | पेटेन्ट्स | 1,50,000 |
| सामान्य संचय | 1,00,000 | देनदार | 2,50,000 |
| लेनदार | 2,00,000 | रोकड़ | 1,00,000 |
| कुल | 15,00,000 | कुल | 15,00,000 |

31 जुलाई, 2023 को वर्षा की मृत्यु हो गई। किसी साझेदार की मृत्यु पर साझेदारी समझौते में निम्न का प्रावधान था :
(i) पूँजी पर ब्याज 6% वार्षिक दर से दिया जाएगा ।
(ii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन पिछले पाँच वर्षों के औसत लाभों के 3 वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर किया जाएगा, जो ₹ 90,000 थे ।
(iii) मृत्यु की तिथि तक लाभ अथवा हानि में वर्षा के भाग की गणना विक्रय के आधार पर की जाएगी। 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष का विक्रय ₹ 60,00,000 था तथा 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से 31 जुलाई, 2023 तक ₹ 15,00,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष का लाभ ₹ 12,00,000 था ।

Aditi, Renu and Varsha were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:5. On 31st March, 2023 their Balance Sheet was as under:
Balance Sheet of Aditi, Renu and Varsha as at 31st March, 2023

| Liabilities | Amount ₹ | Assets | Amount ₹ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capitals: Aditi | 5,00,000 | Buildings | 6,00,000 |
| Renu | 4,00,000 | Machinery | 3,00,000 |
| Varsha | 3,00,000 | Stock | 1,00,000 |
| | 12,00,000 | Patents | 1,50,000 |
| General Reserve | 1,00,000 | Debtors | 2,50,000 |
| Creditors | 2,00,000 | Cash | 1,00,000 |
| Total | 15,00,000 | Total | 15,00,000 |

Varsha died on 31st July, 2023. The partnership deed provided for the following, on the death of a partner:
(i) Interest on capital was to be provided @ 6% p.a.
(ii) Goodwill of the firm was to be valued at 3 years purchase of average profits of the previous five years which were ₹ 90,000.
(iii) Varsha's share of profit or loss till the date of death was to be calculated on the basis of sales. Sales for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 60,00,000 and that from 1st April, 2023 to 31st July, 2023 amounted to ₹ 15,00,000. The profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 was ₹ 12,00,000.
Prepare Varsha's Capital Account to be rendered to her executors.

key_points: Opening balance of Varsha's Capital A/c (Credit) = ₹3,00,000.
Share of General Reserve = 1,00,000 × 5/10 = ₹50,000.
Varsha survived for 4 months (April to July). Interest on Capital = 3,00,000 × 6% × 4/12 = ₹6,000.
Calculation of Goodwill: Average Profit = 90,000. Firm's Goodwill = 90,000 × 3 = 2,70,000. Varsha's share = 2,70,000 × 5/10 = ₹1,35,000.
Calculation of Profit till death: Last year's profit percentage = (12,00,000 / 60,00,000) × 100 = 20%.
Estimated profit for 4 months (on 15,00,000 sales) = 20% of 15,00,000 = 3,00,000. Varsha's share = 3,00,000 × 5/10 = ₹1,50,000.
Total of Credit Side of Varsha's Capital Account = 3,00,000 + 50,000 + 6,000 + 1,35,000 + 1,50,000 = ₹6,41,000.
This entire balance of ₹6,41,000 is transferred to Varsha's Executors Account.

questions.solution: Varsha's Capital Account compiles all amounts payable to her executors. Commencing on the credit side, her opening capital balance from the Balance Sheet is securely logged at ₹3,00,000. Next, her 5/10th share of the undivided ₹1,00,000 General Reserve adds a clean ₹50,000. Since she tragically died on 31st July, she actively survived for 4 months of the current year. The required 6% Interest on Capital is calculated for this precise duration: ₹3,00,000 × 6% × 4/12, which strictly equals ₹6,000. For goodwill, the firm's total value rests at 3 years' purchase of the ₹90,000 average profit, making ₹2,70,000. Varsha's proportional 5/10th share is ₹1,35,000, compensated collectively by Aditi and Renu. Finally, her share of interim profit is meticulously derived via sales ratio. Last year, a profit of ₹12,00,000 on sales of ₹60,00,000 established a clear 20% profit margin. Applying this 20% margin to the current year's interim sales of ₹15,00,000 projects a firm profit of ₹3,00,000. Varsha's half-share of this interim profit is exactly ₹1,50,000, credited via Profit & Loss Suspense Account. The grand total of all these specific credits reaches ₹6,41,000, which is then definitively transferred in full to Varsha's Executors Account to close her ledger.
questions.solution_hindi: वर्षा का पूंजी खाता उसके निष्पादकों को देय सभी राशियों को संकलित करता है। क्रेडिट पक्ष पर शुरू करते हुए, बैलेंस शीट से उसका शुरुआती पूंजी शेष ₹3,00,000 पर सुरक्षित रूप से लॉग किया गया है। इसके बाद, अविभाजित ₹1,00,000 सामान्य संचय का उसका 5/10 वां हिस्सा ₹50,000 जोड़ता है। चूंकि 31 जुलाई को उनकी मृत्यु हो गई थी, इसलिए वह चालू वर्ष के 4 महीनों तक सक्रिय रूप से जीवित रहीं। इस सटीक अवधि के लिए आवश्यक 6% पूंजी पर ब्याज की गणना की जाती है: ₹3,00,000 × 6% × 4/12, जो सख्ती से ₹6,000 के बराबर है। ख्याति के लिए, फर्म का कुल मूल्य ₹90,000 के औसत लाभ के 3 साल की खरीद पर निर्भर करता है, जिससे ₹2,70,000 बनते हैं। वर्षा का आनुपातिक 5/10 वां हिस्सा ₹1,35,000 है, जिसकी भरपाई अदिति और रेनू द्वारा सामूहिक रूप से की जाती है। अंत में, अंतरिम लाभ का उसका हिस्सा बिक्री अनुपात के माध्यम से सावधानीपूर्वक प्राप्त किया जाता है। पिछले साल, ₹60,00,000 की बिक्री पर ₹12,00,000 के लाभ ने 20% स्पष्ट लाभ मार्जिन स्थापित किया था। चालू वर्ष की ₹15,00,000 की अंतरिम बिक्री पर इस 20% मार्जिन को लागू करने से ₹3,00,000 का फर्म लाभ परिलक्षित होता है। इस अंतरिम लाभ में वर्षा का आधा हिस्सा ठीक ₹1,50,000 है, जिसे लाभ और हानि सस्पेंस खाते के माध्यम से क्रेडिट किया गया है। इन सभी विशिष्ट क्रेडिट का कुल योग ₹6,41,000 तक पहुंचता है, जिसे बाद में उसके बहीखाते को बंद करने के लिए वर्षा के निष्पादक खाते में पूर्ण रूप से स्थानांतरित कर दिया जाता है।

questions.text_english:
RR Ltd. was registered with an authorised capital of ₹ 8,00,000 divided into 80,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each. The company offered to the public for subscription 40,000 equity shares. The amount per share was payable as follows:
On Application ₹ 5
On Allotment ₹ 3
On first and final call Balance
The issue was fully subscribed and all amounts due were received except the allotment and call money on 2,000 shares allotted to Seema. These equity shares were forfeited.
Present the Share Capital in the Balance Sheet of the company as per Schedule III, Part I of the Companies Act, 2013. Also prepare 'Notes to Accounts' for the same.

key_points: Authorized Capital: 80,000 Equity shares of ₹10 each = ₹8,00,000.
Issued Capital: 40,000 Equity shares of ₹10 each = ₹4,00,000.
Subscribed Capital: 38,000 Equity shares of ₹10 each fully paid up = ₹3,80,000.
Add: Share Forfeiture Account (2,000 shares × ₹5 received on application) = ₹10,000.
Total Share Capital to be shown in the Balance Sheet = ₹3,90,000.

questions.solution: In the Notes to Accounts for Share Capital, you first declare the Authorized Capital as 80,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each, equaling ₹8,00,000. Following this, state the Issued Capital as 40,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each, equating to ₹4,00,000. Under Subscribed Capital, since 2,000 shares held by Seema were completely forfeited and not reissued, only 38,000 shares remain active. Present this under the specific category 'Subscribed and Fully Paid up' as 38,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each, which strictly amounts to ₹3,80,000. Crucially, the amount the company already collected on Seema's 2,000 forfeited shares is the ₹5 application money, generating ₹10,000. This ₹10,000 must be explicitly shown under 'Add: Share Forfeiture Account'. Therefore, the final total of Share Capital to be securely extracted to the main Balance Sheet under the 'Equity and Liabilities' heading is recorded precisely as ₹3,90,000.
questions.solution_hindi: शेयर पूंजी के लिए खातों के नोट्स (Notes to Accounts) में, आप पहले अधिकृत पूंजी को ₹10 प्रत्येक के 80,000 इक्विटी शेयरों के रूप में घोषित करते हैं, जो ₹8,00,000 के बराबर है। इसके बाद, जारी की गई पूंजी को ₹10 प्रत्येक के 40,000 इक्विटी शेयरों के रूप में बताएं, जो ₹4,00,000 के बराबर है। सब्सक्राइब्ड कैपिटल के तहत, चूंकि सीमा द्वारा रखे गए 2,000 शेयरों को पूरी तरह से जब्त कर लिया गया था और फिर से जारी नहीं किया गया था, इसलिए केवल 38,000 शेयर सक्रिय रहते हैं। इसे विशिष्ट श्रेणी 'सब्सक्राइब्ड और पूरी तरह से भुगतान' के तहत ₹10 प्रत्येक के 38,000 इक्विटी शेयरों के रूप में प्रस्तुत करें, जो सख्ती से ₹3,80,000 है। महत्वपूर्ण रूप से, कंपनी ने सीमा के 2,000 जब्त किए गए शेयरों पर जो राशि पहले ही एकत्र कर ली है, वह ₹5 आवेदन राशि है, जो ₹10,000 उत्पन्न करती है। इस ₹10,000 को स्पष्ट रूप से 'जोड़ें: शेयर जब्ती खाता' के तहत दिखाया जाना चाहिए। इसलिए, 'इक्विटी और देनदारियां' शीर्षक के तहत मुख्य बैलेंस शीट में सुरक्षित रूप से निकाली जाने वाली शेयर पूंजी का अंतिम योग ठीक ₹3,90,000 के रूप में दर्ज किया गया है।

questions.text_english:
Pass necessary journal entries for issue of debentures for the following transactions
(i) Suhavo Ltd. issued 10,000, 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a discount of 10%, redeemable at a premium of 5%.
(ii) Mudit Ltd. issued 20,000, 9% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 5%, redeemable at a premium of 10%.
(iii) Sudip Ltd. issued 30,000, 8% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at par, redeemable at a premium of 5%.

key_points: (i) Issue price = 90. Bank receipt = 10,000 × 90 = 9,00,000. Premium on redemption = 5%. Loss on issue = Discount (10) + Premium on Red (5) = 15 per debenture. Loss = 10,000 × 15 = 1,50,000.

(i) Entry: Bank A/c Dr 9,00,000 To Debenture App & Allot A/c 9,00,000. Debenture App & Allot A/c Dr 9,00,000, Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr 1,50,000 To 11% Debentures A/c 10,00,000 To Premium on Redemption of Debentures A/c 50,000.
(ii) Issue price = 105. Bank receipt = 20,000 × 105 = 21,00,000. Premium on redemption = 10%. Loss on issue = 10 per debenture. Loss = 20,000 × 10 = 2,00,000.

(ii) Entry: Bank A/c Dr 21,00,000 To Debenture App & Allot A/c 21,00,000. Debenture App & Allot A/c Dr 21,00,000, Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr 2,00,000 To 9% Debentures A/c 20,00,000 To Securities Premium Reserve A/c 1,00,000 To Premium on Redemption of Debentures A/c 2,00,000.
(iii) Issue price = 100. Bank receipt = 30,000 × 100 = 30,00,000. Premium on redemption = 5%. Loss on issue = 5 per debenture. Loss = 30,000 × 5 = 1,50,000.

(iii) Entry: Bank A/c Dr 30,00,000 To Debenture App & Allot A/c 30,00,000. Debenture App & Allot A/c Dr 30,00,000, Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr 1,50,000 To 8% Debentures A/c 30,00,000 To Premium on Redemption of Debentures A/c 1,50,000.

questions.solution: The journal entries securely capture the issue terms considering their respective redemption liabilities. For case (i), Suhavo Ltd. issues at a 10% discount (₹90), collecting ₹9,00,000. The redemption commands a 5% premium. The aggregate loss on issue is ₹15 per debenture (₹10 discount + ₹5 redemption premium), totaling ₹1,50,000. The allotment entry debits App & Allotment for ₹9L, debits Loss on Issue for ₹1.5L, credits 11% Debentures for ₹10L, and credits Premium on Redemption for ₹50,000. For case (ii), Mudit Ltd. issues at a 5% premium (₹105), collecting ₹21,00,000. Redemption demands a ₹10 premium. The allotment entry strictly debits App & Allotment for ₹21L, debits Loss on Issue for ₹2L (₹10 × 20k), credits 9% Debentures for ₹20L, credits Securities Premium Reserve for ₹1L, and credits Premium on Redemption for ₹2L. Finally, for case (iii), Sudip Ltd. issues purely at par (₹100), gathering ₹30,00,000. The future redemption at a 5% premium constitutes a loss of ₹1,50,000. The allotment entry clearly debits App & Allotment for ₹30L, debits Loss on Issue for ₹1.5L, crediting 8% Debentures for ₹30L and Premium on Redemption for ₹1.5L.

questions.text:
शर्मा और वर्मा की साझेदारी फर्म के विघटन पर विभिन्न परिसम्पत्तियों (रोकड़ एवं बैंक शेष के अतिरिक्त) तथा बाह्य देयताओं को वसूली खाते में स्थानान्तरित करने के पश्चात् निम्नलिखित लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए :
(i) शर्मा ने लेनदारों के ₹ 40,000 के दावे के लिए पूर्ण निपटान के रूप में ₹ 34,000 का भुगतान किया ।
(ii) वर्मा ने अपनी पत्नी के ₹ 80,000 के ऋण के भुगतान के लिए सहमति दी ।
(iii) एक पुराना टाइपराइटर था जिसे पुस्तकों से पूर्ण रूप से अपलिखित कर दिया गया था । यह अनुमान लगाया गया कि इससे ₹ 3,000 की वसूली होगी । इसे वर्मा ने अनुमानित मूल्य से 20% कम पर ले लिया ।
(iv) एक पुरानी ग्राहक नीलू ने, जिसके ₹ 1,500 के खाते को गत वर्ष डूबत ऋण के रूप में अपलिखित कर दिया गया था, इस राशि के 80% का भुगतान कर दिया ।
(v) ₹ 8,000 के विघटन व्ययों का भुगतान शर्मा द्वारा किया गया ।
(vi) ₹ 40,000 की वसूली की हानि को शर्मा तथा वर्मा के बीच उनके लाभ विभाजन अनुपात 3 : 2 में वितरित कर दिया गया ।
questions.text_english:
Pass the necessary journal entries for the following transactions on the dissolution of the partnership firm of Sharma and Verma after the various assets (other than cash and bank balance) and outside liabilities have been transferred to Realisation Account:
(i) Sharma paid creditors ₹ 34,000 in full settlement of their claim of ₹ 40,000.
(ii) Verma agreed to pay his wife's loan of ₹ 80,000.
(iii) There was an old typewriter which had been written off completely from the books. It was estimated to realise ₹ 3,000. It was taken away by Verma at the estimated price less 20%.
(iv) Neelu, an old customer whose account for ₹ 1,500 was written off as bad debt in the previous year, paid 80% of the amount.
(v) Dissolution expenses amounting to ₹ 8,000 were paid by Sharma.
(vi) Loss on realisation ₹ 40,000 was to be distributed between Sharma and Verma in their profit sharing ratio 3: 2.

key_points: (i) Sharma paid creditors ₹34,000. Realisation A/c Dr 34,000 To Sharma's Capital A/c 34,000.
(ii) Verma took over wife's loan. Realisation A/c Dr 80,000 To Verma's Capital A/c 80,000.
(iii) Verma took unrecorded typewriter at 3,000 - 20% = 2,400. Verma's Capital A/c Dr 2,400 To Realisation A/c 2,400.
(iv) Bad debt recovered = 80% of 1,500 = 1,200. Bank A/c Dr 1,200 To Realisation A/c 1,200.
(v) Dissolution expenses paid by Sharma. Realisation A/c Dr 8,000 To Sharma's Capital A/c 8,000.
(vi) Loss distributed 3:2. Sharma's Capital A/c Dr 24,000, Verma's Capital A/c Dr 16,000 To Realisation A/c 40,000.

questions.solution: The dissolution journal entries carefully record the settlement post transfer. For transaction (i), Sharma personally pays off the firm's creditors for ₹34,000. The entry debits Realisation Account and credits Sharma's Capital Account for ₹34,000, entirely ignoring the original ₹40,000 claim value. In transaction (ii), Verma assumes the liability of his wife's loan. This triggers a debit to Realisation and a credit to Verma's Capital for ₹80,000. For (iii), the unrecorded typewriter is taken by Verma at a 20% discount on the ₹3,000 estimate, which equals ₹2,400. This debits Verma's Capital and credits Realisation for ₹2,400. For transaction (iv), recovering 80% of a ₹1,500 written-off bad debt yields ₹1,200 cash. The entry directly debits Bank and credits Realisation for ₹1,200. In (v), Sharma pays the firm's ₹8,000 dissolution expenses, leading to a debit to Realisation and a credit to Sharma's Capital for ₹8,000. Lastly, for (vi), the total Realisation Loss of ₹40,000 is distributed in their 3:2 ratio. The firm cleanly records this by debiting Sharma's Capital for ₹24,000 and Verma's Capital for ₹16,000, while crediting the Realisation Account for ₹40,000 to close it.
questions.solution_hindi: विघटन जर्नल प्रविष्टियां हस्तांतरण के बाद के निपटान को सावधानीपूर्वक दर्ज करती हैं। लेन-देन (i) के लिए, शर्मा व्यक्तिगत रूप से ₹34,000 के लिए फर्म के लेनदारों का भुगतान करते हैं। प्रविष्टि मूल ₹40,000 के दावे मूल्य को पूरी तरह से अनदेखा करते हुए, वसूली खाते को डेबिट करती है और शर्मा के पूंजी खाते को ₹34,000 के लिए क्रेडिट करती है। लेन-देन (ii) में, वर्मा अपनी पत्नी के ऋण की देयता ग्रहण करता है। यह वसूली खाते में एक डेबिट और ₹80,000 के लिए वर्मा की पूंजी में एक क्रेडिट को ट्रिगर करता है। (iii) के लिए, अलिखित टाइपराइटर को वर्मा द्वारा ₹3,000 के अनुमान पर 20% की छूट पर लिया जाता है, जो ₹2,400 के बराबर है। यह वर्मा की पूंजी को डेबिट करता है और ₹2,400 के लिए वसूली खाते को क्रेडिट करता है। लेन-देन (iv) के लिए, ₹1,500 के लिखित-अप डूबे हुए ऋण का 80% वसूलने पर ₹1,200 नकद प्राप्त होते हैं। प्रविष्टि सीधे बैंक को डेबिट करती है और ₹1,200 के लिए वसूली खाते को क्रेडिट करती है। (v) में, शर्मा फर्म के ₹8,000 के विघटन व्यय का भुगतान करते हैं, जिससे वसूली खाते में डेबिट और ₹8,000 के लिए शर्मा की पूंजी में क्रेडिट होता है। अंत में, (vi) के लिए, ₹40,000 की कुल वसूली हानि को उनके 3:2 अनुपात में वितरित किया जाता है। फर्म इसे बंद करने के लिए शर्मा की पूंजी को ₹24,000 और वर्मा की पूंजी को ₹16,000 के लिए डेबिट करके, जबकि वसूली खाते को ₹40,000 के लिए क्रेडिट करके इसे साफ-सुथरा दर्ज करती है।

(a) Sanju and Manju were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3: 2. Their Balance Sheet on 31st March, 2023 was as follows:
Balance Sheet of Sanju and Manju as at 31st March, 2023

| Liabilities | Amount ₹ | Assets | Amount ₹ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capitals: Sanju | 1,40,000 | Plant and Machinery | 80,000 |
| Manju | 1,20,000 | Furniture | 1,32,000 |
| | 2,60,000 | Investments | 60,000 |
| General Reserve | 40,000 | Debtors | 76,000 |
| Creditors | 1,80,000 | Less: Provision for doubtful debts | 4,000 |
| | | | 72,000 |
| | | Cash at Bank | 1,36,000 |
| Total | 4,80,000 | Total | 4,80,000 |

On 1st April, 2023, Uday was admitted into the firm for 1/4th share in profits on the following terms:
(i) Furniture was to be depreciated by ₹ 6,000.
(ii) Investments were valued at ₹ 72,000.
(iii) Plant and Machinery was taken over by Sanju and Manju in their profit sharing ratio.
(iv) Uday will bring in proportionate capital and ₹ 10,000 as his share of goodwill premium in cash.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts.

key_points: Revaluation Account: Debit Furniture by 6,000. Credit Investments by 12,000 (72k - 60k). Net Revaluation Profit = 6,000. Distributed in 3:2 (Sanju 3,600, Manju 2,400).
Goodwill Premium: ₹10,000 brought by Uday distributed in sacrificing ratio 3:2 (Sanju 6,000, Manju 4,000).
General Reserve: ₹40,000 distributed in old ratio 3:2 (Sanju 24,000, Manju 16,000).
Plant and Machinery taken over: Debited to Capital A/cs in 3:2 (Sanju 48,000, Manju 32,000).
Total Adjusted Capital of old partners = 1,25,600 + 1,10,400 = ₹2,36,000.
Uday's proportionate capital = (2,36,000 × 4/3) × 1/4 = ₹78,667 (approx) or purely 2,36,000 × 1/3 = ₹78,667. Uday brings this amount in cash.

sub_questions.solution: The Revaluation Account documents a precise depreciation on Furniture of ₹6,000. Conversely, Investments appreciated from ₹60,000 to ₹72,000, yielding a ₹12,000 profit. The net Revaluation Profit stands at ₹6,000, distributed to Sanju (₹3,600) and Manju (₹2,400) in their 3:2 old ratio. In the Partners' Capital Accounts, opening balances of ₹1,40,000 (Sanju) and ₹1,20,000 (Manju) are credited. The ₹40,000 General Reserve is credited as ₹24,000 and ₹16,000 respectively. Uday brings ₹10,000 as goodwill premium, which is credited in the 3:2 sacrificing ratio: ₹6,000 to Sanju and ₹4,000 to Manju. Sanju and Manju directly take over the ₹80,000 Plant and Machinery in their 3:2 ratio, meaning their capital accounts are heavily debited by ₹48,000 and ₹32,000. Post adjustments, Sanju's closing capital becomes ₹1,25,600, while Manju's settles at ₹1,10,400. Their combined adjusted capital is ₹2,36,000, which fundamentally represents a 3/4th share of the newly reconstituted firm. Therefore, Uday's 1/4th proportionate capital contribution is calculated precisely as ₹2,36,000 multiplied by 1/3, which legally obligates him to bring in ₹78,667 in cash.

Balance Sheet of Ravi, Tanu and Sara as at 31st March, 2023

| Liabilities | Amount ₹ | Assets | Amount ₹ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capitals: Ravi | 80,000 | Fixed Assets | 1,20,000 |
| Tanu | 1,24,000 | Stock | 1,60,000 |
| Sara | 66,000 | Debtors | 2,00,000 |
| | 2,70,000 | Cash in hand | 80,000 |
| Profit and Loss | 1,70,000 | | |
| Employees' Provident Fund | 20,000 | | |
| Creditors | 1,00,000 | | |
| Total | 5,60,000 | Total | 5,60,000 |

Additional Information
(i) Creditors included a sum of ₹ 4,000 which was not likely to be claimed.
(ii) A provision of 5% for doubtful debts was to be created on debtors.
(iii) Goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 1,60,000.
(iv) Fixed Assets were found overvalued by ₹ 5,000.
(v) New profit sharing ratio of Tanu and Sara was agreed at 2: 3.
(vi) The amount due to Ravi was transferred to his loan account.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts on Ravi's retirement.

key_points: Revaluation Account: Credit Creditors 4,000. Debit PDD (5% of 2,00,000) 10,000. Debit Fixed Assets (overvalued) 5,000. Net Revaluation Loss = 11,000. Distributed 5:3:2 (Ravi 5,500, Tanu 3,300, Sara 2,200).
Profit and Loss balance (Liability side) = ₹1,70,000. Distributed in 5:3:2 (Ravi 85,000, Tanu 51,000, Sara 34,000).

Goodwill adjustment: Firm's GW = 1,60,000. Ravi's share = 80,000. Gaining ratio = New - Old. Tanu = 2/5 - 3/10 = 1/10. Sara = 3/5 - 2/10 = 4/10. Gaining ratio is 1:4. Tanu Dr 16,000, Sara Dr 64,000 To Ravi 80,000.
Ravi's Capital A/c: Opening 80,000 + P&L 85,000 + GW 80,000 - Reval 5,500 = ₹2,39,500. Transferred to Loan A/c.
Tanu's Capital A/c: Opening 1,24,000 + P&L 51,000 - GW 16,000 - Reval 3,300 = ₹1,55,700.
Sara's Capital A/c: Opening 66,000 + P&L 34,000 - GW 64,000 - Reval 2,200 = ₹33,800.

sub_questions.solution: The Revaluation Account reveals a loss. A ₹4,000 unclaimable creditor balance is credited. However, debits include a heavy ₹10,000 Provision for Doubtful Debts (5% of ₹2,00,000) and ₹5,000 for overvalued Fixed Assets. The net Revaluation Loss of ₹11,000 is distributed in the old 5:3:2 ratio: Ravi (₹5,500), Tanu (₹3,300), and Sara (₹2,200). In the Capital Accounts, start with opening balances: Ravi (₹80,000), Tanu (₹1,24,000), and Sara (₹66,000). The accumulated Profit & Loss balance of ₹1,70,000 is credited in the old ratio, granting ₹85,000, ₹51,000, and ₹34,000 respectively. The firm's total goodwill is ₹1,60,000, making retiring Ravi's 5/10 share exactly ₹80,000. The new ratio for Tanu and Sara is 2:3. Their gaining ratio is determined by subtracting the old from the new (Tanu: 2/5 - 3/10 = 1/10; Sara: 3/5 - 2/10 = 4/10), establishing a 1:4 gaining ratio. Thus, Tanu's and Sara's capital accounts are heavily debited by ₹16,000 and ₹64,000 to compensate Ravi. After processing all entries, Ravi's final closing balance amounts to a substantial ₹2,39,500, which is cleanly transferred to his Loan Account. The continuing partners close with respective balances of ₹1,55,700 for Tanu and ₹33,800 for Sara.

(b) Zee Ltd. invited applications for issuing 40,000 shares of ₹ 10 each at a premium of ₹ 2 per share. The amount was payable as follows:

On First call ₹ 2 per share
On Second and Final call Balance
Applications were received for 60,000 shares. Applications for 12,000 shares were rejected and money returned to the applicants. The shares were allotted on pro-rata basis to the applicants of 48,000 shares. The excess money received on application was adjusted towards sums due on allotment. All shareholders paid the allotment money except one shareholder who had applied for 1,200 shares. His shares were forfeited immediately after allotment. First call was made thereafter and all the money due was received. The second and final call was not yet made. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Zee Ltd.

key_points: Total application money received = 60,000 × 4 = ₹2,40,000.
Capital requirement = 40,000 × 4 = ₹1,60,000. Refund = 12,000 × 4 = ₹48,000. Adjusted to Allotment = 8,000 × 4 = ₹32,000.
Allotment Due = 40,000 × 5 = ₹2,00,000. (Capital 1,20,000; Premium 80,000).
Defaulter's allotted shares = 1,200 × (40,000 / 48,000) = 1,000 shares.
Defaulter's paid application money = 1,200 × 4 = ₹4,800. Required on app = 1,000 × 4 = ₹4,000. Excess = ₹800.
Defaulter's allotment due = 1,000 × 5 = ₹5,000. Calls in Arrears = 5,000 - 800 = ₹4,200.
Allotment received in Bank = Total Due (2,00,000) - Advance Adjusted (32,000) - Arrears (4,200) = ₹1,63,800.

Forfeiture: Called up capital = 1,000 × 7 = 7,000. Premium unpaid = 1,000 × 2 = 2,000. Paid (Forfeited) = 4,800. Entry: Share Capital A/c Dr 7,000, SPR A/c Dr 2,000 To Share Forfeiture A/c 4,800 To Calls in Arrears 4,200.
First Call Due on remaining 39,000 shares = 39,000 × 2 = ₹78,000. Full amount received.

sub_questions.solution: Zee Ltd. received ₹2,40,000 on application for 60,000 shares (at ₹4 each). The company rejected 12,000 applications, instantly refunding ₹48,000. The remaining 48,000 applicants received a pro-rata allotment of 40,000 shares. The base application capital transferred is ₹1,60,000. The excess application money from the pro-rata group is ₹32,000 (8,000 shares × ₹4), which is comprehensively adjusted towards Share Allotment. The massive Allotment due is ₹2,00,000 (₹5 × 40k), split into ₹1,20,000 capital and ₹80,000 premium. A shareholder who applied for 1,200 shares was proportionately allotted 1,000 shares. They paid ₹4,800 on application, utilizing ₹4,000 for application capital and carrying a rigid ₹800 excess to allotment. Their allotment due is ₹5,000. Since they failed to pay, their exact Calls in Arrears is ₹4,200 (₹5,000 - ₹800). The total cash received on allotment is therefore the initial due (₹2,00,000) less the pro-rata advance (₹32,000) and less these specific arrears (₹4,200), culminating in exactly ₹1,63,800. The defaulter's 1,000 shares are immediately forfeited. The called-up capital is ₹7 per share (₹4 app + ₹3 allot cap). The forfeiture entry firmly debits Share Capital for ₹7,000 and Securities Premium Reserve for ₹2,000, whilst crediting Share Forfeiture for the ₹4,800 genuinely received and Calls in Arrears for ₹4,200. Following forfeiture, only 39,000 active shares remain. The First Call is strictly made for ₹78,000 (39,000 shares × ₹2), and the entire amount is cleanly received in the bank.

questions.solution: The Current Ratio is Current Assets over Current Liabilities, currently resting at 2:1. Repayment of a long-term loan utilizes cash, which rigidly decreases Current Assets without simultaneously decreasing Current Liabilities (since the loan was non-current). A reduction in the numerator with an unchanged denominator mathematically guarantees a definitive decrease in the Current Ratio.

questions.solution: According to Schedule III Part I of the Companies Act, 2013, the items are accurately classified as follows. Firstly, 'Livestock' falls firmly under the Major Head of 'Non-Current Assets', with its specific Sub-head being 'Property, Plant and Equipment and Intangible Assets' (specifically Property, Plant and Equipment). questions.text_english:
From the following information calculate 'Gross Profit Ratio':

| | |
|---|---|
| Revenue from operations | 10,00,000 |
| Purchases | 3,00,000 |
| Carriage inwards | 60,000 |
| Salaries | 1,18,000 |
| Decrease in inventory | 40,000 |
| Returns outwards | 20,000 |
| Wages | 50,000 |

key_points: Cost of Revenue from Operations (COGS) = Decrease in Inventory + Net Purchases + Direct Expenses.
Net Purchases = Purchases (3,00,000) - Returns outwards (20,000) = 2,80,000.
Direct Expenses = Carriage inwards (60,000) + Wages (50,000) = 1,10,000. (Salaries are indirect, ignored).
Gross Profit = Revenue from operations - COGS = 10,00,000 - 4,30,000 = 5,70,000.
Gross Profit Ratio = (Gross Profit / Revenue from operations) × 100 = (5,70,000 / 10,00,000) × 100 = 57%.

questions.solution: To calculate the Gross Profit Ratio, first determine the Cost of Revenue from Operations (COGS). Net Purchases equal total Purchases (₹3,00,000) minus Returns Outwards (₹20,000), which is ₹2,80,000. Direct expenses explicitly include Carriage Inwards (₹60,000) and Wages (₹50,000); Salaries are indirect and firmly ignored. COGS is calculated by summing the Decrease in Inventory (₹40,000), Net Purchases (₹2,80,000), and Direct Expenses (₹1,10,000), resulting in exactly ₹4,30,000. Gross Profit is then found by subtracting COGS from Revenue from Operations: ₹10,00,000 - ₹4,30,000 = ₹5,70,000. Finally, the Gross Profit Ratio is ₹5,70,000 divided by ₹10,00,000, multiplied by 100, yielding a precise 57%.
questions.solution_hindi: सकल लाभ अनुपात (Gross Profit Ratio) की गणना करने के लिए, पहले संचालन से राजस्व की लागत (COGS) निर्धारित करें। शुद्ध खरीद कुल खरीद (₹3,00,000) माइनस बाहरी वापसी (₹20,000) के बराबर है, जो ₹2,80,000 है। प्रत्यक्ष खर्चों में स्पष्ट रूप से आवक भाड़ा (₹60,000) और मजदूरी (₹50,000) शामिल हैं; वेतन अप्रत्यक्ष है और इसे दृढ़ता से नजरअंदाज किया जाता है। COGS की गणना इन्वेंट्री में कमी (₹40,000), शुद्ध खरीद (₹2,80,000), और प्रत्यक्ष व्यय (₹1,10,000) को जोड़कर की जाती है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप ठीक ₹4,30,000 प्राप्त होता है। सकल लाभ तब संचालन से राजस्व में से COGS घटाकर पाया जाता है: ₹10,00,000 - ₹4,30,000 = ₹5,70,000। अंत में, सकल लाभ अनुपात ₹5,70,000 को ₹10,00,000 से विभाजित करके, 100 से गुणा करके, सटीक 57% प्राप्त होता है।

Notes to Accounts:
1. Reserves and Surplus: Surplus (31.3.2023: 1,50,000; 31.3.2022: 1,00,000)
2. Long-term Borrowings: 10% Debentures (31.3.2023: 1,20,000; 31.3.2022: 85,000)
3. Short-term Provisions: Provision for Tax (31.3.2023: 25,000; 31.3.2022: 38,500)
4. Tangible Assets: Machinery (6,35,000; 5,00,000), Less: Accumulated Depreciation (-1,00,000; -75,000)
5. Intangible Assets: Goodwill (20,000; 56,000)

Additional Information:
(i) A piece of machinery costing ₹ 12,000 on which accumulated depreciation was ₹ 8,000 was sold for ₹ 3,000.
(ii) Interest paid on 10% Debentures amounted to ₹ 8,500.

key_points: Net Profit Before Tax & Extraordinary Items = Increase in Surplus (50,000) + Provision for Tax made current year (assumed 25,000 since no tax paid given, or usually current year provision is taken). Actually, if tax paid is not given, current year provision is 25,000. So NPBT = 50,000 + 25,000 = 75,000.

Add non-cash/non-operating items: Depreciation for the year. Acc Dep Opening = 75,000. Less sold asset dep = 8,000. Closing should be 67,000. Actual closing = 1,00,000. Therefore, Depreciation provided = 1,00,000 - 67,000 = 33,000.
Add Goodwill amortised = 56,000 - 20,000 = 36,000.
Add Loss on sale of machinery: Cost 12,000 - Acc Dep 8,000 = WDV 4,000. Sold for 3,000. Loss = 1,000.
Add Interest on Debentures paid = 8,500.
Operating Profit before Working Capital changes = 75,000 + 33,000 + 36,000 + 1,000 + 8,500 = 1,53,500.
Working Capital Adjustments: Less Increase in Inventories (4,000), Less Increase in Trade Receivables (13,500), Less Decrease in Trade Payables (12,500). Total deduct = 30,000.
Cash generated from operations = 1,53,500 - 30,000 = 1,23,500.
Less Income Tax Paid (previous year's provision) = 38,500.
Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities = 1,23,500 - 38,500 = 85,000.

questions.solution: The computation systematically deduces the Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities. First, establish the Net Profit Before Tax by taking the net increase in the Surplus balance (₹1,50,000 - ₹1,00,000 = ₹50,000) and adding the current year's Provision for Tax (₹25,000), securing a base of ₹75,000. Next, calculate the year's actual depreciation charge through the Accumulated Depreciation account: Opening balance (₹75,000) minus depreciation on the sold machine (₹8,000) equals ₹67,000; the difference between the closing balance (₹1,00,000) and this ₹67,000 reveals a ₹33,000 depreciation charge. Evaluating the sold machine, its Written Down Value was ₹4,000 (Cost ₹12,000 - Acc Dep ₹8,000). Selling it for ₹3,000 triggers a ₹1,000 loss. To derive Operating Profit before working capital changes, add these non-cash and non-operating debits back to NPBT: Depreciation (₹33,000), Goodwill amortization (₹56,000 - ₹20,000 = ₹36,000), Loss on sale (₹1,000), and Interest on Debentures (₹8,500). This aggregates to an Operating Profit of ₹1,53,500. Adjusting for working capital, deduct the increase in Inventories (₹4,000), the increase in Trade Receivables (₹13,500), and the decrease in Trade Payables (₹12,500), which totals a ₹30,000 deduction, yielding Cash Generated from Operations of ₹1,23,500. Finally, deducting the actual Income Tax Paid (the previous year's provision of ₹38,500) solidly results in a Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities of ₹85,000.
questions.solution_hindi: यह गणना व्यवस्थित रूप से प्रचालन गतिविधियों से नकदी प्रवाह को प्राप्त करती है। सबसे पहले, अधिशेष (Surplus) शेष (₹1,50,000 - ₹1,00,000 = ₹50,000) में शुद्ध वृद्धि लेकर और चालू वर्ष के कर प्रावधान (₹25,000) को जोड़कर कर पूर्व शुद्ध लाभ स्थापित करें, जिससे ₹75,000 का आधार प्राप्त होता है। इसके बाद, संचित मूल्यह्रास खाते के माध्यम से वर्ष के वास्तविक मूल्यह्रास प्रभार की गणना करें: प्रारंभिक शेष (₹75,000) में से बेची गई मशीन (₹8,000) पर मूल्यह्रास घटाकर ₹67,000 के बराबर है; अंतिम शेष (₹1,00,000) और इस ₹67,000 के बीच का अंतर ₹33,000 के मूल्यह्रास प्रभार को प्रकट करता है। बेची गई मशीन का मूल्यांकन करते हुए, इसका अपलिखित मूल्य ₹4,000 (लागत ₹12,000 - संचित मूल्यह्रास ₹8,000) था। इसे ₹3,000 में बेचने पर ₹1,000 का नुकसान होता है। कार्यशील पूंजी में परिवर्तन से पहले परिचालन लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए, इन गैर-नकद और गैर-परिचालन डेबिट को NPBT में वापस जोड़ें: मूल्यह्रास (₹33,000), ख्याति परिशोधन (₹56,000 - ₹20,000 = ₹36,000), बिक्री पर नुकसान (₹1,000), और डिबेंचर पर ब्याज (₹8,500)। यह कुल मिलाकर ₹1,53,500 का परिचालन लाभ है। कार्यशील पूंजी के लिए समायोजन करते हुए, इन्वेंटरी में वृद्धि (₹4,000), व्यापार प्राप्य में वृद्धि (₹13,500), और व्यापार देय में कमी (₹12,500) में कटौती करें, जो कुल ₹30,000 की कटौती है, जिससे संचालन से प्राप्त नकदी ₹1,23,500 प्राप्त होती है। अंत में, भुगतान किए गए वास्तविक आयकर (₹38,500 के पिछले वर्ष के प्रावधान) को घटाने से प्रचालन गतिविधियों से शुद्ध नकद प्रवाह के रूप में ₹85,000 का ठोस परिणाम मिलता है।

questions.solution: Resizing a chart refers to the process of manually adjusting its physical dimensions—specifically its width and height—within a spreadsheet layout, ensuring it fits perfectly within a presentation or report without affecting the actual data being plotted. questions.text_english: State any three limitations of Computerised Accounting System.

key_points: High Cost of Implementation: Requires substantial initial investment in expensive hardware, specialized software, and ongoing maintenance.
Need for Specialized Training: Staff must be adequately trained to operate the software effectively, incurring additional time and training costs.
Security Risks and Data Loss: Highly vulnerable to external hacking, malware, and catastrophic data loss resulting from unexpected system crashes or hardware failures.

questions.solution: While a Computerised Accounting System offers immense speed, it suffers from three distinct limitations. First is the High Cost of Implementation; setting up a reliable system demands heavy initial capital investment in robust hardware, licensed software, and continuous IT maintenance. Second is the persistent Need for Specialized Training. The system cannot be operated by untrained personnel, meaning the organization incurs significant ongoing training costs to keep staff proficient. Third is the severe threat of Security Risks and Data Loss. Unlike physical books, a computerized system is deeply vulnerable to devastating cyberattacks, malicious viruses, and catastrophic data erasure triggered by sudden hardware failures or power crashes.

questions.text: एक दी गई स्प्रेडशीट पर डायलॉग बॉक्स तथा फॉर्मूला टैब का प्रयोग करते हुए 'इफ' (If) कार्य का सृजन करने के चरणों को लिखिए जहाँ कुल आय घटा व्यय यदि ₹ 10,000 से अधिक है, तो 10% बचत और यदि आय ₹ 10,000 से कम है, तो 5% बचत । परिणाम के वाक्य-विन्यास को भी लिखिए ।
questions.text_english: Write the steps to create 'If' function using formula tab and dialogue box on a given spreadsheet where the total income less expenses if greater than ₹ 10,000 then 10% savings and if income is less than ₹ 10,000 then 5% savings. Also write the syntax of the result.

key_points: Step 1: Select the cell where you want the result (savings) to be displayed.
Step 2: Go to the 'Formulas' tab on the Ribbon and click on 'Logical' from the Function Library group.
Step 3: Select 'IF' from the drop-down menu. The Function Arguments dialogue box will appear.
Step 4: In the 'Logical_test' box, enter the condition (e.g., A1-B1 > 10000, assuming Income is in A1 and Expenses in B1).
Step 5: In the 'Value_if_true' box, enter the calculation for 10% savings (e.g., (A1-B1)*10%).
Step 6: In the 'Value_if_false' box, enter the calculation for 5% savings (e.g., (A1-B1)*5%). Click OK.
Syntax: =IF((Income - Expenses) > 10000, (Income - Expenses)*10%, (Income - Expenses)*5%)

questions.solution: To create the 'IF' function using the Formula tab and dialogue box, follow these steps. First, select the cell where you want the savings result to be displayed. Second, go to the 'Formulas' tab on the Ribbon and click on 'Logical' from the Function Library group. Third, select 'IF' from the drop-down menu, which opens the Function Arguments dialogue box. Fourth, in the 'Logical_test' box, enter the condition for the surplus (e.g., assuming Income is in A1 and Expenses in B1, type A1-B1>10000). Fifth, in the 'Value_if_true' box, enter the calculation for 10% savings: (A1-B1)*10%. Sixth, in the 'Value_if_false' box, enter the calculation for 5% savings: (A1-B1)*5%. Finally, click OK. The resulting syntax in the cell will be: =IF((A1-B1)>10000, (A1-B1)*10%, (A1-B1)*5%).
questions.solution_hindi: फॉर्मूला टैब और डायलॉग बॉक्स का उपयोग करके 'IF' फंक्शन बनाने के लिए इन चरणों का पालन करें। सबसे पहले, उस सेल का चयन करें जहां आप बचत परिणाम प्रदर्शित करना चाहते हैं। दूसरा, रिबन पर 'फॉर्मूला' टैब पर जाएं और फंक्शन लाइब्रेरी समूह से 'लॉजिकल' पर क्लिक करें। तीसरा, ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू से 'IF' चुनें, जो फंक्शन आर्ग्यूमेंट्स डायलॉग बॉक्स खोलता है। चौथा, 'Logical_test' बॉक्स में, अधिशेष के लिए शर्त दर्ज करें (उदाहरण के लिए, यह मानते हुए कि आय A1 में है और व्यय B1 में है, टाइप करें A1-B1>10000)। पांचवां, 'Value_if_true' बॉक्स में, 10% बचत के लिए गणना दर्ज करें: (A1-B1)*10%। छठा, 'Value_if_false' बॉक्स में, 5% बचत के लिए गणना दर्ज करें: (A1-B1)*5%। अंत में, OK पर क्लिक करें। सेल में परिणामी सिंटैक्स होगा: =IF((A1-B1)>10000, (A1-B1)*10%, (A1-B1)*5%)।
